name: Paper tooth
sub: White stock that is not a screen. A height field — tooth, formation, laid fibers, pits — lit by the one sheet light. On white the relief can only take light away, so the paper reads through its shadows. FX-01 and FX-02 print into this exact field.

in.o: params object — keys below; every length in CSS px
in.dpr: device px per CSS px (density is physical: marks per CSS px²)

x.S: params of every effect keyed by id; the stock this prints on is read from S[printsOn]
x.umask: optional: clips.umask — a typed or image mask (mShape type | image)

out.lin: Float32Array W·H·3, linear-light sRGB (encode with FX.toRGBA(R,"image",W,H))
out.ink: Float32Array W·H, absorbance / coverage (FX.toRGBA(R,"ink",…) = film positive)
out.stock: Float32Array W·H, stock height (FX.toRGBA(R,"stock",…) = normalized height map)

light.note: az = direction the light comes FROM (screen degrees; 0 = right, 90 = below); el = elevation above the sheet

deterministic: yes — every random draw is a hash of (position, seed); same inputs → same pixels in the same engine

params.label: Tooth scale
params.note: feature size of the tooth (noise wavelength), not a tile zoom

params.label: Octaves
params.note: layers of finer detail

params.label: Fibers
params.note: laid fibers per 100 × 100 CSS px

params.label: Fiber length
params.note: mean fiber length

params.label: Fiber width
params.note: mean fiber width

params.label: Pits
params.note: depressions per 100 × 100 CSS px

params.label: Persistence
params.note: amplitude kept per octave — the spectral dropoff of the tooth

params.label: Distribution
params.note: reshapes height: power in = mostly flat with sparse valleys (smooth stock); out = broad tooth (cold press)

params.label: Anisotropy

limits.why: reads as a stock emboss filter

params.note: tooth stretched along the grain angle — machine-made paper is never isotropic; 1 = the 1999 "paper" filter look

params.label: Formation
params.note: low-frequency cloudiness of the sheet (fiber flocs); also mottles any ink printed on it

params.label: Formation scale
params.note: size of the flocs

params.label: Grain angle
params.note: machine direction of the fibers and the tooth

params.label: Grain spread
params.note: 0 = all fibers on the grain; 1 = any direction

params.label: Relief
params.note: height of the tooth in CSS px — how hard the light can rake it. The slider is weighted to the subtle end.

params.label: Diffuse share
params.note: share of light from the sheet light vs flat ambient fill

params.label: Fiber raise
params.note: how far fibers stand proud of the sheet

params.label: Pit depth
params.note: how deep pits go

params.label: Paper L
params.note: OKLab lightness of the stock under the sheet light. Below 1 so lit walls, foil and sheen have headroom to brighten; 1 = the white of the page (highlights clip)

params.label: Fiber tone
params.note: albedo darkening of fibers

params.label: Pit tone
params.note: albedo darkening in pits

params.label: Fill tint · L
params.note: OKLCH lightness (0 black … 1 white)

params.label: Fill tint · C

limits.why: most hues leave sRGB above ~.26 and get chroma-reduced

params.note: OKLCH chroma; reduced at constant L/h if it leaves sRGB

params.label: Fill tint · h
params.note: OKLCH hue angle

params.label: Fill tint amount
params.note: how much the ambient fill takes the tint (shadows go cool / warm)

params.label: Shape
params.note: the region the effect may occupy — type = your words as the mask; image = upload a PNG/SVG (alpha, or dark = ink)

params.label: Mask text
params.note: set in Archivo 800, fit to the plate

params.label: Inset
params.note: distance from the plate edge to the mask edge

params.label: Edge wander

limits.why: above ~28 px the edge tears into islands

params.note: how far noise pushes the edge in and out

params.label: Wander scale
params.note: wavelength of the wander; small = ragged, large = drifting

params.label: Roughness
params.note: octaves of edge noise — adds fine teeth without moving the large shape

params.label: Feather
params.note: width over which coverage falls from 1 to 0

params.label: Feather as
params.note: speckle = binary marks thinning out; tone = partial coverage

params.label: Sheet lift
params.note: thickness / curl of the sheet — sizes its shadow on the page

params.label: Bite
params.note: clumped dropouts that grow more likely toward the edge

params.label: Seed
params.note: every random draw in the effect hangs off this one number

recipe: Height = fbm at the tooth scale (octaves, persistence = how fast detail drops off), reshaped by the distribution curve; blended with low-frequency formation.
Fibers: curved capsules at a count per 100 × 100 px near the grain angle, raised into the height; pits: small depressions. Both also darken the albedo slightly.
Normal from the height gradient → Lambert under the sheet light (azimuth + elevation from the light puck). Diffuse share vs ambient fill; the fill can be tinted.
The same field is the stock for FX-01 and FX-02: its peaks take ink first, its valleys starve, its fibers wick.
Mask = the sheet's cut or deckle edge; the sheet casts a contact + ambient shadow onto the page by the same light.

limits.what: reads as stucco — the stock-filter emboss look
isotropic tooth reads as a 1999 paper filter
collapses into per-pixel noise — digital grain
every fiber becomes a hard ridge; ok for a raking-light study, not for a page
